[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Introduction:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Your contact list is synced from Smartphone Contacts. Add your friends to Contacts will allow you to text them, just like real![/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]The first message of the day will be the vanilla dialogue. When you continue the conversation, AI will roleplay as the NPC and respond to you.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Your conversation is summarized daily, which help the AI to remember what you discussed, and it will get smarter and smarter overtime.[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[/list]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]UnlimitedEventExpansion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46249]>>> here[/url][/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]A companion mod to Messenger that allowing you to schedule event with NPCs (for example: picnics, dining out, birthday parties, etc.).[/size][/font][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Usage limit and more:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][size=2][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]This mod costs me [b][i][u]REAL MONEY[/u][/i][/b] for every message you send. For me and other fellow players, please use it responsibly.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]To help balance the costs, you are limited to a certain number of uses per in-game day. To bypass this limitation, you can get and use your own OpenAI API key, which means you will be paying for your own usage.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232][size=2][b][i][u]HIGHLY RECOMMENED:[/u][/i][/b] It is very easy and cheap ([b]and even free[/b]) to use your own key. You will no longer face daily limits and will have a much better overall experience. See the instructions under [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4386]IMPROTANT: GET YOUR OWN KEY[/url][/size][/color][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Compatablility:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Other language: Change AI language in Config -> Language[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Multiplayer: Fully supported. Players can text and send photo to each other. [/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Custom NPCs: Fully supported for Vanilla and SVE. Other custom NPCs require manual customization for the best quality (see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4384]instruction[/url]).[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Mobile: Fully supported[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]Split-screen: Not tested. Likely not work.[/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ff00][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]Customization:[/size][/font][/color][/left]
[left][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]FOR USERS: You can tailor the experience to your liking, including the phone's theme and NPC characteristics (how they will respond to you), and more. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=articles]USER GUIDE[/url][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]FOR ADVANCE USERS: You can provide custom API to call to any provider/local LLM. See [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4405]ADVANCE[/url][/font][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS]FOR MODDERS: Messenger provides APIs to send message to/from NPC. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46248?tab=articles]MODDER GUIDE[/url][/font][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]

[left][font=Comic Sans MS][i]
[color=#00ff00]Disclaimer:[/color][/i][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][i]This mod revolves around the use of AI. Please do not come here just to point out that it uses AI—that's the whole point![/i][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Your messages are sent to ChatGPT to generate responses, similar to how you use it everyday. Because of this, it is a good practice to [u]not[/u] include sensitive information in your messages - for example your credit card numbers.[/i][/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][i]The mod generate a summary of your conversation with the NPC and save it in the mod folder. That mean the more you talk with the NPC, the smarter the response you have.[/i][/font][/color][/*]
[/list]
